stories.headline: The Joyless Return of ‘Ted Lasso’ - The Free Press
stories.summary: The show’s newest season replaces real character complexity, depth, and heart with big, sweeping political statements that stir progressive pundits and academics and precisely no one else, writes Lie…
stories.why: Ted Lasso's decay from genuine character drama into preachy political messaging signals how prestige TV has abandoned the male audience it once served—prioritizing ideology over storytelling in ways that feel increasingly alienating to guys who just want compelling narratives.

stories.headline: Jane Schoenbrun On Tackling "Toxic Soup" Of Slasher Genre In 'Camp Miasma' - deadline.com
stories.summary: With their latest directorial outing, 'Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma', Jane Schoenbrun deconstructed the toxic elements of the slasher genre.
stories.why: Jane Schoenbrun's deconstructing the slasher genre signals how Gen-Z filmmakers are actively rewriting the male-coded horror traditions this demographic grew up with, reframing familiar tropes through a deliberately antagonistic lens toward traditional masculinity.

stories.headline: Paramount Will Put 30-Film Pledge in Writing to Theater Chains - Bloomberg.com
stories.summary: Paramount Skydance Corp. has agreed to sign contracts with major theater chains guaranteeing that it will release 30 movies a year in cinemas if it acquires Warner Bros. Discovery Inc., according to…
stories.why: Paramount's contractual commitment to 30 films annually directly impacts whether guys can still experience blockbusters on the big screen rather than streaming—a concrete bet that theatrical cinema matters enough to legally guarantee it.
